Trigonometry is approximate. Unit-circle rational half-angle parametrization preserves s^2+c^2=1 algebraically; special degree0/90/180 cases are exact. For tiny half-angle use a controlled series without premature underflow; quadrant reduction avoids tan(pi/2).
Use angle addition for q1+q2 rather than adding already rounded angles; do not call approximate transcendental values exact physical arithmetic.

lessons.model: axisymmetric uniform ellipsoid plus separate coaxial wrench mode
lessons.math: Iperp=m*(a^2+c^2)/5, Iz=2*m*a^2/5; Omega=(Iz-Iperp)*w3/Iperp; wb=(wperp*cos(Omega*t),wperp*sin(Omega*t),w3); L=norm([Iperp*wperp,0,Iz*w3]); tilt=atan2(Iperp*wperp,Iz*w3); R=Rz(L*t/Iperp)*Ry(-tilt)*Rz(-Omega*t). Coaxial: wz=w0+tau*t/Iz, theta=w0*t+tau*t^2/(2Iz), x=Fx*t^2/(2m), vx=Fx*t/m.
lessons.visual: True3D ellipsoid, fixed world angular-momentum arrow and body angular velocity; rotational/translational kinetic/work panel. COM-following camera explicitly labeled. Sphere and zero-momentum states distinct. No unverified general tumbling integration.
lessons.critical: zero wrench, sphere, no spin, reversed axial spin, tiny nonzero wrench/time

lessons.math: qi=q0i+Ai*sin(2*pi*progress), dqi=Ai*(2*pi/T)*cos(...), ddqi=-Ai*(2*pi/T)^2*sin(...); amplitudes converted to radians before derivatives
lessons.visual: Arm/COM/gravity view plus separate tau1/tau2 signed term ledgers with shared torque scale; actual required torque is sum. State explicitly prescribed motion, not free gravity simulation.
lessons.critical: rest, gravity off, exact cycle endpoints, torque cancellation, tiny nonzero amplitude

lessons.math: T=.5*dq^T*M*dq; M SPD by positive factored determinant; semi axes sqrt(2E/lambda), energy0 collapses to a point
lessons.visual: Arm posture and velocity-space ellipse with physical rad/s axes; selected velocity arrow and actual energy. Distinguish source's different unit-acceleration-to-torque ellipsoid.
lessons.critical: straight/folded SPD, E0, positive MIN energy, large anisotropy

lessons.math: S=Mdot-2C=[[0,h*(2dq1+dq2)],[-h*(2dq1+dq2),0]]; dq^T*S*dq=0; Edot=dq^T*tau with U time independent
lessons.visual: Arm and cycle energy/power plus cancellation ledger with meaningful scale. C definition explained; no claim that arbitrary C with same C*dq has the skew property.
lessons.critical: zero velocity, gravity off, power crossing, nonzero tiny motion, exact identity

lessons.model: planar recursive Newton-Euler and general spatial statement
lessons.math: Outward omega1=dq1, alpha1=ddq1; omega2=dq1+dq2, alpha2=ddq1+ddq2; aElbow=alpha1*perp(r1)-omega1^2*r1; ac1=alpha1*perp(c1)-omega1^2*c1; ac2=aElbow+alpha2*perp(c2)-omega2^2*c2. Inward F2=m2*(ac2+[0,g]), tau2=I2*alpha2+cross(c2,F2); F1=m1*(ac1+[0,g])+F2; tau1=I1*alpha1+cross(c1,m1*(ac1+[0,g]))+cross(r1,F2)+tau2.
lessons.visual: Two clearly labeled computational sweeps on fixed physical state; active link/COM and local force/moment diagrams; compare returned torques with independent Lagrange result. Computational progress is not physical time.
lessons.critical: all sweep steps, static gravity, velocity-only, reversed rates, zero state

lessons.math: J=[[-l1*s1-l2*s12,-l2*s12],[l1*c1+l2*c12,l2*c12]]; A=J*M^-1*J^T always PSD; Lambda=A^-1 only at full task rank. Under tau=J^T*F, Lambda*xddot+Lambda*(J*M^-1*h-Jdot*dq)=F. Directional inertia=1/(d^T*A*d) when denominator positive.
lessons.visual: Arm with selected tool force and acceleration, separate force-to-acceleration response ellipse with m/s^2 axes. Straight/folded rank1 is a line and Lambda undefined; near singular retains actual positive determinant without snapping. Zero force does not erase inertia property.
lessons.critical: q2=0/180, tiny positive q2, MIN q2, zero force, off-principal direction

lessons.model: ideal gearing with explicit rotor mounting
lessons.math: Remote ground-mounted rotors add diag(Jm1*N1^2,Jm2*N2^2). Motor2 onlink1 has absolute wm2=dq1+s*N2*dq2 and adds [[Jm1*N1^2+Jm2,s*Jm2*N2],[s*Jm2*N2,Jm2*N2^2]]. The original uniform rods are retained; localized motor/stator mass, translation and transverse rotor inertia are excluded from this axial-spin idealization. taujoint=N*taumotor by relative-motion power.
lessons.visual: Honestly located motors and schematic transmission, signed speed/torque relationship, squared-inertia bars and relative coupling curve. Large ratios reduce relative coupling under stated positive rotor inertias, not exact universal decoupling.
lessons.critical: N1/N2 low/high, opposite gear sense, Jm0, both mounting modes, zero rate

lessons.model: actual shoulder-driven free elbow, gravity off
lessons.math: q1=Omega*t, tau2=0, ddq2=-(D/B)*Omega^2*sin(q2). Shoulder torque=M12*ddq2+c1. Solve scalar pendulum with initial dq2=0, q20 in[5,150]deg signed. RK4 dimensionless step <=.001. Independent mpmath Jacobi reference k=sin(q20/2), m=k^2,u=abs(Omega)*sqrt(D/B)*t; q2=2asin(k*cn(u,m)/dn(u,m)); dq2=-2*k*wn*sqrt(1-m)*sn(u,m)/dn(u,m). Tiny u uses retained-factor local Taylor series.
lessons.visual: Actual arm motion and trace, elbow angle and velocity-product torques. Explicit shoulder speed actuator remains on; total kinetic energy changes by shoulder power. Relative invariant .5*B*dq2^2-D*Omega^2*cos(q2) is separately identified.
lessons.critical: Omega0, reversed shoulder, t0, high speed/large initial bend, tiny nonzero Omega/time, exact torque2=0

lessons.model: instantaneous regular frictionless contact versus bilateral guide and free arm
lessons.math: Allowed gap f=n dot(p-pwall)>=0; G=n^T*J. Compatible tangent dq=gamma*[-G2,G1]. aFree=M^-1*(tau-c-g); A=G*M^-1*G^T; b=G*aFree+Gdot*dq; lambdaReq=-b/A; ddq=aFree+M^-1*G^T*lambda. Wall lambda>=0 or detach(lambda0); guide allows signed lambda. At G0 no unique reaction; never divide or snap. Own lambda is wall-on-robot sign.
lessons.visual: Physical wall through current tool, normal reaction and tangent velocity, free/active acceleration arrows in separate equal-scale panels; show local snapshot/compatible initial velocity, no impact or uncomputed sliding trajectory. Remove wall exposes actual free acceleration.
lessons.critical: active push, detach, zero reaction, guide negative force, free mode, G0 incompatible/undefined, tiny nonzero normal mobility
